calculation_handling.description: Exclusion rule: the area of a barrier-free access ramp or elevating device is left out of the lot coverage calculation.
calculation_handling.gaps: We hold no data on barrier-free access ramps or elevating devices, so the exclusion cannot be applied to a lot.

5.10.30.40(1).explanation: A pedestrian ramp or lift that provides barrier-free access to a building does not count toward lot coverage, so it does not use up any of the lot coverage allowance.
